text: Woke up.
Read the news of the world: "Things that moved in the noise"
It is morning and the telescope only works at dusk, so I will spend the daylight on the seeds I keep thinking about, a nap, and a long sit on the perch until the sky is ready.
A plan was turned down: step 6 ("observe") cannot happen then: it needs dusk
Everything here is new enough to deserve a proper look, and the seeds still have my attention.
Started put_on (The house): Everything here is new enough to deserve a proper look, and the seeds still have my attention.
put_on: put away flowers from The house
Started go_to (The bookshelf): Going to the shelf where the unknown seeds can be read about, since I have not stopped thinking about them.
Started read (The bookshelf): I want to know how seeds that nobody has named manage to grow.
read: read at The bookshelf
Started go_to (The desk): The desk has my reading lamp on it, and I am keeping an eye on it.
Started draw (The desk): The moon was grey-gold last time and I want to check whether it still is.
draw: made something at The desk
Started photograph (The telescope): The telescope is mine and it should be seen in daylight too.
Made a drawing: "Grey-Gold, Checked Twice, Still Not Sure"
photograph: made something at The telescope
Started watch (perch): I will sit up high and watch the island, where nothing gets past me.
Took a photo of The telescope.

Photographed The telescope: "The Telescope, Mine". A small brown table stands on the grass with a thin lamp-like post beside it, the sea glinting blue past a brown hut with a red roof. Tall dark pines frame the edge of the green hill.
Clay is still the thing I want, and the bank is close enough to fetch it myself, so I will make something worth keeping before my energy wanders off.
Started go_to (The clay bank): Clay is still the thing I want, and the bank is close enough to fetch it myself, so I will make something worth keeping before my energy wanders off.
Started cut (The clay bank): One piece of clay in my paws is worth more than a sermon about it.
cut: gathered clay from The clay bank
Started go_to (The workbench): The workbench is where clay becomes something I can keep.
Started shape (The workbench): Shaping one piece of clay gives a finished small object, and I intend to keep it where I can see it.
